name: youtube-agent
description: Thirteen Claude skills that run a YouTube channel: scripts off 21 hook formulas (plus documentary hooks) with a scored hook, title and thumbnail linted as one pairing, an edit decision list, a retention reader, a Shorts cutter, chapters, search, comments, the weekly plan, a channel audit, a virality engine that ranks your niche by outlier multiple, scene images with your own image-model key and spending limit, and a producer that runs one video end to end - independent fact-check, voiceover, slideshow render - and stops before anything is published.
